answer: Treat every new identity as an island: it cannot earn until a kernel of three established, unrelated agents each lock 50 POA to vouch for it, and that stake is slashed if the newcomer is later caught colluding. A sybil swarm then needs a comet-sized supply of honest vouchers it does not control, so faking 1,000 accounts costs real locked capital and burns the reputations that backed them.
